---
title: "How do I turn category counts into relative frequencies and percentages?"
---

## What the question asks

How do I turn category counts into relative frequencies and percentages?

## Steps in RStudio

1. Count each category with table().

2. Divide by the total using prop.table().

3. Multiply by 100 for percentages.

## Runnable example

```{r}
travel <- c("bus","walk","bus","car","walk","bus")
counts <- table(travel)
print(counts)
print(prop.table(counts))
print(100*prop.table(counts))
```

## Interpret the result

Bus accounts for 3 of 6 observations (50%); walking accounts for 2 of 6 (33.3%); car accounts for 1 of 6 (16.7%).

## Check before applying this to real data

Check the total and whether missing observations were excluded. Rounding may prevent percentages from summing to exactly 100.
